    """
    Set the number of PIN and PUK retries.
    NOTE: This will reset the PIN and PUK to their factory defaults.
    """
    ctx.logger.info("Setting the number of PIN and PUK retries.")

            ctx.logger.info("The key already exists. Use --force to override this.")
            return

            "pin": pin,
